question: What features are used?
title: Automatic Classification of Pathology Reports using TF-IDF Features
answer_rationale: The documents repeatedly mention the use of TF-IDF features for extracting keywords and classifying pathology reports. For example, Text 1 states that TF-IDF features are extracted from training reports and used to train classifiers, and Text 3 confirms that TF-IDF features were used to classify reports using SVM, XGBoost, and Logistic Regression. Text 4 also highlights that TF-IDF feature vectors combined with classifiers like linear SVM or XGBoost are effective for classification.
